note: Re-judged at HEAD against RFC 4271 Section 5 ("Some of these attributes are mandatory and MUST be included in every UPDATE message that contains NLRI."). Positive: TestRFC4271UpdateWithNLRICarriesTheMandatoryAttributes proves BuildUnicast includes ORIGIN, AS_PATH and NEXT_HOP on eBGP and iBGP when body NLRI is present (and places IPv4+IPv6 Extended Next Hop in MP_REACH_NLRI with empty body NLRI); TestRFC4271WellKnownAttributesAreRecognized proves ValidateUpdateRFC7606 accepts all well-known attributes with NLRI. Negative: TestBuildUnicastRefusesIPv4RouteWithNoUsableNextHop proves BuildUnicast returns ErrUnicastNextHopUnusable rather than emit NLRI without NEXT_HOP; TestRFC4271UpdateWithNLRICarriesTheMandatoryAttributes proves bare routes still receive mandatory attributes; TestRFC4271WellKnownAttributeErrorsAreCaught proves missing ORIGIN triggers exact TreatAsWithdraw + AttrCode 1.
